newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish state 5 pct bond seen yielding 6.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Danish state 5 pct bond seen yielding 6.3 pct.

text.p: A new Danish government five percent, eight year bond going on sale on January 14 is likely to open with a yield around 33 basis points below the benchmark 10-year bond or 26 bp below the theoretical yield curve, a BG Bank analysis said on Friday.
At Friday's rates such a spread would give a yield around 6.31 percent before tax and a price of 91.48.
The national bank will announce the maximum volume and opening price of the offer at 0800 GMT on Tuesday and open the auction two hours later.
Low-coupon paper is tax-effective for private investors.

A three billion crown four percent T-bill offer on January 7 sold out in minutes, driven by strong demand and low volume. BG Bank believed that the new five percent bond, due in 2005, could benefit from a similar effect if released in the same quantity. --Soeren Linding Jakobsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969653
